notes: Box score from the Clippers' 113–105 home win over the Charlotte Hornets at Intuit Dome on Nov 15, 2026, from the Covers.com box score, matched line for line by the SI and FOX Sports box scores, with game details from Field Level Media, Sport News Africa, Ball Exclusives (via Yardbarker), the Hornets substack and On SI. All 113 Clippers points and all 105 Hornets points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores (22–29–33–29 to 21–31–31–22) add up to both totals: 52–51 Charlotte at the half and 84–83 Los Angeles after three. Team totals (field goals 41 of 74 to 35 of 92, threes 16 of 31 to 17 of 52, assists 32–23, rebounds 37–46, points in the paint 42–36) and the biggest leads (Los Angeles 17, Charlotte 13) are from Covers; the Clippers' 55 bench points are from Sport News Africa and match the box score. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Sunday's games: Los Angeles 4–8 and 12th in the West, Utah 1–13.

Charlotte led 70–57 midway through the third quarter after Coby White scored 16 points in under six minutes (Sport News Africa; the SI play-by-play agrees). Hornets coach Charles Lee was ejected after two technical fouls 17 seconds apart in the third quarter, with Charlotte up 75–72; the Hornets were outscored 41–30 the rest of the way (Field Level Media; On SI). With the game tied 90–90 and 9:33 left, the Clippers went on a 10–0 run, and Gradey Dick's three with 4:14 left made it 111–94, the largest lead of the night (Field Level Media; Sport News Africa). The Clippers have won 17 straight games against Charlotte and are 23–1 against the Hornets since 2014–15 (Field Level Media). Los Angeles hosts Utah on Tuesday, Nov 17 at 10:30 PM ET, and Charlotte plays at the Lakers the same night (Covers schedules; Ball Exclusives).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Max Strus' pull-up 3-pointer, assisted by Brook Lopez, with 9:12 left in the fourth quarter that broke a 90–90 tie and started the Clippers' 10–0 run (the SI play-by-play gives the clock, the score and "pullup jump shot"; Sport News Africa: "Strus set the tone with a three-pointer"). The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the LA Clippers or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Max Strus' listed 6-foot-5 and 215 pounds (RealGM; Basketball-Reference agrees), in the Clippers' home white with No. 31 (RealGM). No wingspan from a named source was found, so his arms are drawn to his height. He has no approved look on file yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette in the kit. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
